text:
Taylor Reed: Heads up — customer hit duplicated subscription records in the sample app during onboarding. Root cause looks like a retry during auth.refresh + upstream 429.

Anya Singh: which sample and SDK?

Taylor Reed: go sample-app v0.9 + go-sdk v0.9.2. The app sets Idempotency-Key but the header is lost when the SDK reconstructs the request after refreshing the token. Python kept it.

Ben Morales: ah we've seen a similar header-filtering issue in the auth middleware before. It reconstructs requests from a small header whitelist.

Taylor Reed: repro logs:
```
2026-03-05T14:12:07Z INFO send POST /v1/subscriptions id=sub_77
2026-03-05T14:12:07Z WARN auth refresh start
2026-03-05T14:12:08Z ERROR upstream 429
2026-03-05T14:12:08Z INFO retrying id=sub_77 headers(Idempotency-Key)=<missing>
2026-03-05T14:12:08Z INFO send POST /v1/subscriptions id=sub_77
```

Anya Singh: missing idempotency header during immediate retry = duplicate risk. Fix options: 1) Preserve user headers in auth replay, 2) synthesize a client-side replay id and local dedupe cache, 3) strict-mode that refuses auto-retry on non-idempotent operations.

Ben Morales: prefer combined approach: preserve user headers by default, add small in-memory replay cache (20s) keyed by method+path+body when no Idempotency-Key present, and expose strictMode flag.

Taylor Reed: agree. For 429 backoff let's standardize on full jitter per AWS guidance: backoff = min(base * 2^attempt, max); sleep = rand(0, backoff). base=250ms, max=6s.

Anya Singh: also add test coverage: unit tests that simulate token refresh + 429 and assert only one backend create call; integration smoke that runs onboarding sample against go & python SDK parity harness.

Ben Morales: implementation notes: update auth middleware to accept "preserve_headers" list in SDK config and default to ["Idempotency-Key", "X-Request-Meta-*"]. Add telemetry events: sdk.replay.missing_idempotency and sdk.replay.deduped_local.

Taylor Reed: add docs: onboarding quickstart should call out idempotency header usage and show enabling strictMode. Also include migration note for existing sample-apps.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEX-4230: "go-sdk: preserve idempotency header across auth retries + local replay cache" https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-4230 :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Ops alert created for customers with matching telemetry pattern (possible duplicate creations).

Anya Singh: follow-up: check streaming resume path as it may reuse the same auth replaying logic. If affected, open DEX-4231.

Ben Morales: I'll send a small PR later today with middleware whitelist change + unit tests; will include a feature flag for strictMode default=false.

Taylor Reed: thanks — please @mention me on the PR.

Anya Singh: QA checklist: matrix test on node/go/python, enable telemetry capture, simulate auth token expiry during POST.

Ben Morales: noted. PR coming.
